scope.candidate_feedback: climate-driven changes in global natural wetland methane emissions recursively passed into FaIR
excluded: a scalar uplift applied to an existing SCC

give_audit.finding: A separate natural CH4 input exists, but its future path is constant and the oxidation bookkeeping does not preserve source attribution for an added biogenic feedback

unit_contract.temperature: annual GMST anomaly in K on the calibration baseline
unit_contract.recommended_delta_form_for_testing: delta_E[t] = slope * (T[t-1] - T_anchor), added to a reconciled natural baseline
unit_contract.causal_lag: temperature through year t-1 determines wetland emissions in year t to avoid a same-timestep algebraic loop

forbidden_claims: wetlands add a fixed percentage to the GIVE SCC
all natural methane in GIVE is wetland methane
wetland methane may be injected through fossil_emiss_CH4
the MAGICC GMST proxy separately identifies precipitation or inundation effects
a published scenario temperature increment is a marginal SCC
unlock_requirements: Partition the GIVE natural methane baseline into wetlands and other natural sources without changing its historical concentration calibration
Harmonize the 2015 temperature baseline and absolute intercept or use a validated anomaly-preserving replacement
Add source-resolved methane oxidation so biogenic wetland methane does not create fossil CO2
Reconcile the wetland source feedback with FaIR methane lifetime and concentration calibration
Prespecify whether negative normal slope draws are retained, truncated, or replaced with a bounded distribution
Bound the GMST-only approximation against precipitation/inundation/hysteresis and process-model alternatives
Implement lagged recursion in baseline and pulse models with identical wetland and FaIR parameter draws
Run zero-feedback, zero-pulse, pre-pulse identity, unit, mass-balance, pulse-size convergence, horizon, and timestep tests
